description: This file defines the AppEnv class responsible for loading environment variables from a .env file using the flutter_dotenv package. It provides a static load() method to initialize environment variables, with checks to prevent re-loading if already loaded.

classes.name: AppEnv
classes.description: A utility class for loading environment variables from a .env file.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads environment variables from the .env file. Can be called multiple times without adverse effects.
